text:
rachel_support: Support -> CS handoff: NovaQ trial stuck in onboarding. Bulk ingest intermittently returns 412 and similarity scores dropped ~20% after a config promotion. Trial activation down to 26%. Sales has a renewal check-in in 4 days. Need a CS bridge + customer note.

tyler_se: Reproduced. The promoted config turned on chunking+dedupe which changed doc chunk boundaries; embeddings mismatch for long docs. Throttling/backpressure also causing 412s. Rolled chunking off for tenant and queued a config revert. Internal ticket 9901.

maria_csm: I'll own the customer-facing comms and bridge. Can someone paste a one-paragraph non-technical line I can send before the call? I'll schedule 30m at 10am PT. @oliver_csm_mgr FYI 94 might need renewal mitigation if metrics don't recover.

oliver_csm_mgr: Acknowledged. Prep renewal mitigation options: (1) 2-week trial extension, (2) account credit, (3) dedicated enablement workshop. Maria, collect customer sentiment on the bridge.

tyler_se: Customer-facing: "We're reverting a recent config change that affected document chunking for your tenant and applied a temporary throttle to stabilize ingestion. Expect improvements within 30-60 minutes; we'll review live on the bridge."

rachel_support: Logs attached to thread. Short extract: `ingest::412 backpressure at 2026-04-02T14:04:21Z`, `embed_delta: 0.91 -> 0.73 post-promo`.

incident_bot: Incident 9901 created and escalated to CS. Priority: P2. Bridge scheduled: 2026-04-02T10:00:00-07:00. Eng oncall notified.

maria_csm: Thanks. Owners: immediate ping = Maria, technical RCA on bridge = Tyler + Rachel, post-call remediation & credits = Oliver. I'll send invite now and post a short apology note before the call.
achel_support: Invite sent; joining 10m early to stream logs.

maria_csm: After the call I'll update the renewal playbook and flag to sales if activation remains <30% within 24h. :thumbsup:
